
Data and analysis related to chills constructed project by Scott Bannister and Tuomas Eerola under the manuscript titled "Musical chills as constructed emotion: How to stop exploring and start explaining" (in prep.). 

# Data

The data comes from manual encoding of papers dealing with chills since year xxxx. The format is .... and the file is available as an Excel sheet titled [`chill_terminology.xls`](data/chill_terminology.xls).

# Visualisation

The notebook called [visualise.qmd](visualise.qmd) creates a network visualisation of chill definitions, affects and physiology (Figure X in manuscript).
